title: HN Post Revival — Email to Mods
author: chipmunk-easel
email_subject: Show HN auto-flagged — genuine project, new account (item 50218042)
email_body:
Hi,

My first Show HN post was auto-killed, likely because my account is brand new:
https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50218042

I'm a microbiologist (Kevin Mok) who built a scientific computing ecosystem in Rust through AI conversation — 3.6M lines across 473 crates, 148 published papers. This is a genuine project, not spam.

The link goes to: https://sporeprint.primals.eco/story/i-dont-know-rust/

Would you be willing to take a look and consider un-flagging it?

Thanks,
Kevin
ecoPrimal on HN
notes: membrane-mailer.py can consume this: python3 membrane-mailer.py --neutrino hn-email
